title: AU-Harness: An Open-Source Toolkit for Efficient and Unified Evaluation of AUdio-LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2509.08031v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) are rapidly advancing, but evaluating them remains challenging due to inefficient and nonstandardized toolkits that limit fair comparison and systematic assessment. Existing evaluation frameworks exhibit three critical limitations: (1) slow and inefficient processing pipeline that bottlenecks large-scale studies, (2) inadequate multi-turn dialogue support, leaving fundamental questions about cross-turn context integration and performance dynamics over extended conversations in LALMs unanswered; and (3) the absence of unified and scalable evaluation framework capable of keeping pace with the rapid growth of both LALMs and audio benchmarks. translated_title: AU-Harness：一个用于高效统一评估音频大语言模型的开源工具包
translated_abstract: 大音频语言模型（LALMs）正在快速发展，但由于评估工具包效率低下且缺乏标准化，限制了公平比较和系统性评估，对其进行评估仍然具有挑战性。现有的评估框架存在三个关键局限性：（1）缓慢且低效的处理流程，成为大规模研究的瓶颈；（2）对多轮对话的支持不足，导致关于LALMs中跨轮上下文整合以及长对话中性能动态变化的基本问题尚未得到解答；（3）缺乏能够跟上LALMs和音频基准快速增长步伐的统一且可扩展的评估框架。为了解决这些问题，我们推出了AU-Harness，一个高效且全面的LALMs评估框架。我们的实证研究表明，AU-Harness相比现有评估工具包将评估处理时间减少了77%，使...
tldr: AU-Harness是一个开源的音频大语言模型统一评估框架，通过高效流水线将评估处理时间减少77%，并解决了现有工具在多轮对话支持不足和框架缺乏标准化方面的关键局限。
en_tdlr: AU-Harness is an open-source evaluation framework for Large Audio Language Models that reduces evaluation processing time by 77%, addressing critical limitations of existing tools including inefficient pipelines, inadequate multi-turn dialogue support, and the lack of a unified scalable evaluation standard.
